    Catmen¶

    One of the Six Main Races of Ge'or — a feline humanoid species found on nearly every continent. Catmen are characterized by cat ears, tails, and a playful, ego-less disposition that makes them the most universally beloved species in the world. They live everywhere: as nomads, in kingdoms, and in cities with playful names.

    Biology¶

    • Appearance: Humanoid with cat ears and tail. Hair (and fur) comes in every color — purple, white, black, green, blue, and all shades between. Build varies by subrace: Lesser Catmen are smaller and delicate, High Catmen are robust and broad-shouldered, Erisdarian Catmen are bright-haired and feminine, Merratodonian Catmen are lean and forest-colored
    • Lifespan: 65–90 years depending on subrace
    • Mage-cell expression: Low. Some Merratodonian Catmen develop minor plant-communication abilities. Catmen prefer agility and wit to spells
    • Traits: Exceptional agility, balance, and curiosity. Keen hearing. Catmen are naturally playful — their games, dances, and pranks are copied across Ge'or

    Society¶

    Catmen society is decentralized and cheerful. There is no single catmen empire — instead, catmen integrate into the societies of other species, or found their own playful nations.

    • Governance: Varies by nation — Estran is an elective monarchy of High Catmen, Lake Kingdom and Great Cattos are Lesser Catmen kingdoms, Marko is ruled by elected High Catmen on an international council. Nomadic catmen answer to no one
    • Culture: Ego-less, silly, and gullible — but brilliant at commerce. Catmen are the trend-setters of Ge'or; their fashions are copied by all species. Their cities and nations follow a playful naming pattern: descriptor + "ko" (see Naming Convention)
    • Relations: Universally loved. No species wages war on catmen — armies simply pass through their territories. Humans of the Venner aristocracy are famously fond of them; the Erisian church forbids human-catmen marriages, but the prohibition is widely ignored
    • Military: Weak by default — catmen survive through universal affection rather than arms
    • Religion: Most catmen follow Calism — a pacifist, gentle philosophy-faith that seeks to greaten oneself. Majority in Marko; most catmen of Lumina follow it as well. The most ancient catmen faith is Sytrenis, founded by the hero Masaaki Sytrenis; most Lesser Catmen still believe in it

    Subraces¶

    • High Catmen — Mediterranean appearance, black-haired, more masculine build (Estran, Demon Continent)
    • Erisdarian Catmen — bright-colored hair, Central European look, feminine, wandering storytellers (Erisdar, Lumina Continent, worldwide)
    • Lesser Catmen — smaller, all colors, the ultimate comic relief, universally liked, nomadic. Born of hunger: the breed appeared out of the Termopolas catmen extermination of the Human Age, as starving catmen were forever changed (everywhere)
    • Merratodonian Catmen — forest-adapted, muted greens and browns, agile climbers (Merratodoni)

    Nations¶

    Catmen live everywhere — as nomads, in kingdoms, and in cities with playful names: - Estran — High Catmen (Yak Island, Demon Continent) - Cattos — island nation of Erisdarian Catmen and Lesser Catmen (Lumina Continent) - Great Cattos — Lesser Catmen country (Lumina Continent) - Lake Kingdom — Lesser Catmen kingdom (Lumina Continent) - Marko — ruled by elected High Catmen (Kutten) - Minorities in: Gigas Tribe, Lumina Republic, Cammao Kingdom, Venner, and countless others

    Naming Convention¶

    Catmen names follow a simple pattern: descriptor + "ko": - "alcohol cat" → Alko - "tall cat" → Tallko Cities and nations follow similarly: Cattos, Great Cattos.

    Connections¶

    • One of the Six Main Races: Humans, Dwarves, Elves, Demons, Beast Races
    • Traits: Ego-less, silly, gullible — but brilliant at commerce
    • Military: Weak by default — survive through universal affection
    • Fashion: Trend-setters of Ge'or — copied by all species
    • Subrace nations: Estran, Cattos, Great Cattos, Lake Kingdom, Marko
    • Found: Everywhere on Ge'or
    • Religion: Calism (majority)
